title: Figure 5: IEC fusor schematic and Polywell confinement device photo
description: Side-by-side figure: a line-drawn engineering schematic of an "IEC Fusor" vacuum chamber with concentric grid cathode, ion guns, gas flow controller and labelled dimensions, and a photograph of the "POLYWELL" device, a cluster of polished toroidal magnet coils on a stand. Captioned "Figure 5. IEC Fusor and Polywell Confinement Configurations." The text describes electrostatic confinement, the Farnsworth-Hirsch Fusor, the Polywell and the Penning trap/POPS concepts.
